question.text: Which statement is incorrect with reference to inner transition elements?

options.text: The oxides of lanthanoids are basic
Pm is radioactive element among actinoids
The values of ionization enthalpy of actinoids are less than the values of ionization enthalpy of lanthanoids
Only in the electronic configuration of lanthanoids like Ce,Gd, Lu the electrons are filled in 5d orbitals

solution.text: Pm is not actinoids, its a lanthanide
